title: How This Man Stole $40,000 From an ATM
description:
On May 26, 2022, officers responded to a burglary call at a bowling alley. The robber had broken in through the back door and was last seen leaving the parking lot by one of the officers. The male claimed that he was in the area to meet his girl but he couldn’t produce her address or phone number while the CCTV footage from the bowling alley was telling a compelling story of its own. The ATM machine of the bowling alley had been broken into and a search of the male’s vehicle revealed two crow bars, two pairs of gloves, and a grey metal box. The suspect was identified as 37-year-old Frederick who was out on bond for a similar burglary charge at the time of his arrest. A bag of cash amounting over $40,000 was recovered from his car. He was charged with commercial burglary and theft while his bond was set at $5,000.
